init_distributed_training: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group using a config object with rank, world size, and init method
gather_picklable_data: gather arbitrary picklable data from all ranks to a destination rank using the gloo backend
all_gather_picklable_data: all-gather arbitrary picklable data from all ranks and return a list of data on every rank
reduce_tensor_across_ranks: reduce a tensor across all processes by averaging it on rank zero using dist.reduce
suppress_non_master_output: suppress print and warning output on non-master ranks by monkey-patching builtins with a force flag
